products.title: Legend Sweater Shirt - Charcoal Black Buffalo
products.body_html:
Our iconic Legend Sweater Shirt is made from a custom double-knit fabric that feels soft like a sweater but looks like your favorite button-up. With built-in stretch, an easy drape, and classic workshirt details, it gives you the comfort of your softest tee with the versatility and polish of an everyday button-up.

  • Fit: Relaxed Fit, Length 29 ¾"
  • Detail: Spread collar. Button front and cuff. Two chest buttoned patch pockets. Shirttail hem.
  • Material: Deer Lodge Plaid: 64% REPREVE® Recycled Polyester, 34% LENZING™ ECOVERO™ Viscose, 2% Elastane Charcoal Black Buffalo: 65% REPREVE® Recycled Polyester, 30% LENZING™ ECOVERO™ Viscose, 5% Elastane Dark Azure Twill: 64% REPREVE® Recycled Polyester, 34% LENZING™ ECOVERO™ Viscose, 2% Elastane
  • Care: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Cool iron when needed.
  • MXC0002-CBB

products.title: The Movement Shirt (Tall) - Azure Sky
products.body_html:
Incredibly soft and airy, the magic of this button-up shirt first comes from our custom-developed Supima Cotton blend. Its extra-long staple fiber is renowned for producing the smoothest and finest yarn with natural performance qualities. Then we added the perfect amount of stretch — so it’s comfortable all day. Easy to care for, with clean, refined tailoring, it's the shirt you can always count on no matter where you're going or who you're meeting.

  • Detail: Spread collar with concealed buttons to prevent fly-away. Button front and cuffs. Shirttail hem.
  • Material: 55% Supima® Cotton, 25% Recycled Nylon, 16% TENCEL™ Lyocell, 4% Spandex
  • Care: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Cool iron when needed.
  • MWC0088-ASK

products.title: Long-Sleeve Recycled Terry Tee - Coastal Cream
products.body_html:
This vintage-inspired long-sleeve tee is crafted from lightweight French terry in a blend of organic and recycled cotton, with a relaxed fit and soft feel that gets even better over time. Garment dyeing creates subtle variation in color, giving each piece a naturally worn-in look.

  • Fit: Relaxed Fit, Length 28 ½"
  • Detail: Set-in knit rib at collar and cuffs. Set-in sleeves. Woven sun & waves label at wearer's left hem
  • Material: 70% Organic Cotton, 30% Recycled Cotton
  • Model: Anarcius is 6'1" wearing size Medium
  • Care: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Cool iron when needed.
  • MKF2600-CTL

products.title: Throwback Crew - Varsity Orchard
products.body_html:
Inspired by collegiate sportswear, this classic crewneck sweater is crafted from an ultra-soft organic cotton-cashmere blend for an easy, comfortable feel. An airy waffle texture adds dimension and breathability while staying warm, giving this cool-weather staple an elevated upgrade for everyday layering.

  • Fit: Classic Fit, Length: 23"
  • Detail: Waffle stitch long-sleeve pullover. Rib trim at sleeve cuffs, bottom hem, and neckline.
  • Material: 95% Organic Cotton, 5% Cashmere
  • Model: Lily is 5'9" wearing size Small
  • Care: Hand wash cold with like colors. Do not bleach. Lay flat to dry. Cool iron if needed. Dry cleanable.
  • WYH2320-VOD

products.title: Philadelphia 76ers Legend Sweater Rugby Popover - Brighton Navy Twill
products.body_html:
Part of our new NBA partnership, this Faherty favorite celebrates the 76ers and generations of Philly fans who’ve stood behind their team.

Crafted from our signature Legend fabric with an ultra-soft, sweater-like feel, this rugby popover has all the comfort of your favorite knit with a polished, throw-on-and-go look. Easy to layer, it’s a highly wearable piece that instantly elevates your Saturday morning coffee run.

  • Fit: Relaxed Fit, 25 ¾" from shoulder, 27" back length
  • Detail: Long sleeve popover with spread collar. Half placket with concealed functional buttons. Side slits at bottom hem.
  • Material: 65% REPREVE® Recycled Polyester, 30% LENZING™ECOVERO™Viscose, 5% Elastane
  • Model: Sharyna is 5'10" wearing size Small
  • Care: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Cool iron when needed.
  • WPF2626-AVT
